faq: Will cleanup break my live product links?

We avoid changing live links. When a duplicate has to go, we set a redirect to the product we keep, so shoppers and search engines land on a working page. Anything risky is listed for your approval first.
Can you clean up before I move to a new platform?
Yes, and it is often the best time. We tidy the catalog in your current store so the export is clean. If you also want the move done, see our product data imports service.
What if I do not know what is wrong with my catalog?

That is normal. We start by scanning for duplicates, missing fields, empty categories and odd variants, then give you a plain list ranked by how much each one affects shoppers. You choose what we fix.
Not without your say. We mark candidates as draft or archived first, and only delete when you confirm in writing. That way a mistake is always reversible.
